## Change

What problem does this solve, and is it shared or platform-specific?

## Evidence

Baseline commit/version, affected skills, actual output comparisons, regressions, and authorization. Link existing learning records; do not paste private client evidence here. For infrastructure-only changes, state that limitation.

## Checks

- [ ] `python3 check.py` passes
- [ ] Source, adapters and generated packages reviewed together
- [ ] Behavioral evidence and existing promotion requirements satisfied, or explicitly held
- [ ] Platforms tested and untested are stated
- [ ] Rollback reference recorded
